name: Commerce NZ Post
description: Commerce Shipping method that fetches live international rates from the NZ Post RateFinder API.
project_description:
Integration of the NZ Post rate estimation API with Commerce Shipping. Provides estimated shipping costs for range of NZ Post international services. Does not currently provide domestic estimates. If using the Drupal 10 version ensure you read the included Readme file for known limitations.

 This module requires an API key with NZ Post to access their shipping calculations. You can apply for one free to developer@nzpost.co.nz .

 4.x Info

 commerce_shipping 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Enable the "Commerce NZ Post" module 
 Visit `Commerce > Configuration > Shipping Methods` to configure. You will need your NZ Post API key

 7.x Info 
 
Requirements for 7.x 
 
 commerce 
 commerce_shipping (7.x-2.x) 
 commerce_physical 
 
 Install as usual, see http://drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-7 for further information.

 Configuration 
 
 Go to Store -> Shipping -> Shipping Methods 
 Edit the NZ Post Method 
 Put in your NZ Post API key 
 Select the shipping methods you wish to make available in your store 
 Go to Store -> Products -> Product Types -> Edit your product type 
 Add physical dimensions and physical weight to your product 
 Update your available products with physical details 
 Done! (See your shipping checkout page).
